Client Overview

Fuel Me

Illinois-based fuel delivery company serving commercial and residential customers.

The Challenge

Fuel Me was struggling to compete in a crowded fuel delivery market. Despite offering competitive pricing and reliable service, they were:

  • Invisible on Google for key search terms like “fuel delivery near me”
  • Spending $5,000/month on Google Ads with minimal ROI
  • Getting outranked by national competitors with bigger budgets
  • Unable to track which marketing efforts were actually driving customers
 
Our Solution

Three-Phase Strategy

Phase 1: Foundation

  • Technical SEO Audit: Fixed critical website issues including slow load times and mobile responsiveness
  • Keyword Research: Identified 50+ high-intent keywords specific to fuel delivery services
  • Competitor Analysis: Analyzed top competitors to find content and backlink opportunities
  • Conversion Tracking: Implemented proper analytics to track phone calls and form submissions

Phase 2: Content & SEO

  • Local SEO: Optimized Google Business Profile, built 25+ local citations
  • Content Strategy: Published 12 blog posts targeting fuel delivery topics
  • Service Pages: Built dedicated pages for each service area and fuel type
  • Schema Markup: Implemented LocalBusiness and Service schema

Phase 3: Paid Advertising

  • Google Ads Restructure: Rebuilt campaigns with proper audience targeting
  • Geographic Targeting: Focused ad spend on high-value service areas
  • Ad Copy Optimization: Created urgency-driven copy emphasizing same-day delivery
  • Landing Pages: Built high-converting pages with clear CTAs

Key Wins

  • Achieved #1 rankings for 15 primary keywords including “fuel delivery Illinois”
  • Reduced cost per click from $8.50 to $3.20 while increasing conversion rate from 2.1% to 7.8%
  • Increased qualified leads by 210%
  • Achieved 85% impression share for priority keywords
